text:
arya: Trying the JS SDK quickstart in Cloudflare + Bun. Cloudflare: ReferenceError: require is not defined. Bun: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for deep export. Any recommended packaging pattern?

mike: Exports map + an explicit /edge subpath helped us: "exports": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "./edge": "./dist/worker.mjs" }. Samples import 'redwood-sdk/edge'.

devon: Typings: our overloaded signatures leak any. Move to single generic: `create<T = unknown>(opts: CreateOpts<T>): Promise<CreateResp<T>>` with discriminant like `kind:'text'|'json'`. Defaults to unknown so callers opt-in.

arya: Build hiccup: esbuild fails when sample uses explicit generics. We had `preserveValueImports:true` and `isolatedModules:true`. Switching sample tsconfig to `preserveValueImports:false` and `declaration:false` fixed esbuild.

ci-bot: ci: sample-build (node 18) shows bun matrix failure. I'll add a compat re-export for Bun and a short README note.
